subject: Request: BlueRock Onramp — Startup credits for NovaRise
messages:
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@bluerock.vc>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: onramp@bluerock.vc
Date: 2026-11-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: BlueRock nominee — NovaRise (credits request)

Hi Jordan,

BlueRock is running our Winter Onramp cohort and we'd like to nominate one of our portfolio companies, NovaRise (founder@novarise.ai), for Redwood's startup credits program. NovaRise is building an internal agent orchestration layer and will need sustained inference for model tuning and evals.

Can you confirm eligibility for a.) self-serve onramp credits and b.) a 6-month trial extension on top of the standard credits for cohort participants? Attached is our nomination letter (blueRock_nomination.pdf).

Quick background on NovaRise: 8 people, pre-seed (raise closing next month), data residency US.

If there's a simple verification checklist we can complete (VC attestation + company registration), we'd like to get this on the portal so the founder can redeem without a contract handoff.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Nguyen
Principal, BlueRock Ventures
Sasha@bluerock.vc

---- Attachment: blueRock_nomination.pdf (application letter, 1 page)

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@bluerock.vc>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BlueRock nominee — NovaRise (credits request)

Hi Sasha — thanks for the nomination and the context.

We can absolutely support onramp nominations via the self-serve credits flow. To expedite, please have the founder complete two quick items:

1) Self-serve eligibility form (one-click link): https://console.redwood.ai/self-serve/credits/verify?token=zzY4K
2) Upload a scanned VC attestation (a short PDF from BlueRock confirming cohort placement) or forward your nomination email to onramp@bluerock.vc so we can reconcile.

If both are present we can provision:
- Standard onramp credits: 100k tokens (usable on hosted API)
- Option: +6 month trial extension (temporarily extend expiration date) — subject to intake review.

I'll loop in Karthik to confirm the allocation and approvals on our end. Once verified, we can generate a redemption link that the founder redeems directly in the Console (no contract required for the standard onramp award).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: recommended onramp award for NovaRise (BlueRock)

Team — reviewing the nomination: BlueRock + NovaRise look clean. My suggested approach:

- Award: 100k token credit (hosted API)
- Trial extension: 6 months from issuance (so effectively 9 months from sign-up for PLG redemptions)
- Activation path: self-serve redemption link generated by Jordan once we store the attestation PDF in the intake folder

Notes / risks:
- Vet that founder email matches company domain + registration (avoid generic Gmail without evidence)
- If usage goes > X tokens/day we may auto-cap and route to a Dedicated consult (we'll notify the account)

I can sign off if Marissa is OK with the extension. Monica: will this count toward our onramp partner quota for Q4?

-Karthik

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: recommended onramp award for NovaRise (BlueRock)

Thanks — go ahead and provision the 100k credits + 6 month extension pending the attestation doc from BlueRock attached to the intake ticket. Two quick asks before issuance:

1) Have BlueRock sign a very short attestation (we accept the nomination email but need a line confirming that NovaRise is a cohort startup). That can be a one-paragraph PDF; the applicant can forward it to onramp@bluerock.vc and we'll store it.
2) Add the redemption code to the "partner credits" ledger with tag: onramp/bluerock/Q4. This is for tracking usage and ROI on the partner program.

If BlueRock provides the attestation today, Jordan — please issue by EOD tomorrow so NovaRise can start testing.

-Marissa
VP, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@bluerock.vc>

Jordan / team — attaching the attestation PDF (blueRock_nomination.pdf) and confirming founder@novarise.ai is the correct primary contact.

BlueRock confirms NovaRise is an official Winter Onramp cohort participant (cohort id: BR-W2026). Please let me know if you need a corporate registration doc; founder can upload.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — a self-serve redemption would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sasha

Redemption details:
- Redemption link (one-time use): https://console.redwood.ai/self-serve/redeem?code=RB-ONRAMP-6M-9F7Q

If you run into any issues redeeming: reply to this thread or use the Console "Support -> Partner Intake" flow and tag "onramp/bluerock".

Welcome to Redwood — excited to see what NovaRise builds.

Best,
